proposal.rationale: Chapter 93B is NC's umbrella occupational licensing board statute. Nearly every section in Chapter 93B uses the phrase "occupational licensing board(s)" as the subject of a duty or prohibition (e.g., "Each occupational licensing board shall...", "No occupational licensing board shall...", "Any occupational licensing board which..."). This is the strong universal signal for NC — these provisions apply to every occupational licensing board in the state, and therefore to every profession regulated by such a board. Adding "(?:each|any|no|every) occupational licensing board" and "occupational licensing boards shall" as chapter-level universal patterns captures §§ 93B-2 through 93B-8.2 that the walker previously left undetermined. § 93B-1 itself is the definitions section and is handled by the cross-state "As used in this Chapter" detector. Section/chapter cite patterns and standard triggers are unchanged.
